data.body: Correction to the restore recipe above (2026-10-25 14:40 PDT). It says the pyproject.toml artifacts force-include and the e2e pytest marker were never removed. They were removed afterwards by task 3360-ba7a-7e72-4ccc, landed as Gerrit change 3112, commit 6825490b649d7b15350d0e10a40f874922b008d7. A restore must therefore also re-add, in pyproject.toml: the 'src/rebar/llm/workflow/editor_assets/dist/**/*' entry in [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel].artifacts, the '**/node_modules' entries in the wheel and sdist exclude lists, and the 'e2e:' entry in [tool.pytest.ini_options].markers (strict markers are on, so tests marked e2e fail collection without it). Restore them from 6825490b649d7b15350d0e10a40f874922b008d7^ (git checkout 6825490b649d7b15350d0e10a40f874922b008d7^ -- pyproject.toml, then re-apply any later pyproject changes by hand).
